lines.s: The rapporteur supports the creation of the EUCSA. Regarding its seat, he aligns the provisions of the proposal with the recent case-law of the European Court of Justice. The amendments tabled in committee were published on 30 May 2023. On 14 November 2023 the draft report was adopted in LIBE committee and on 16 November 2023 the LIBE report was tabled to the Plenary. On 22 November 2023 the LIBE committee decision to enter into interinstitutional negotiations was confirmed by plenary (Rule 71). The rapporteur gave an update on the current discussions in LIBE on 6 May 2026.

At the Council, the common position took a long time and several presidencies to be agreed upon. The Belgian, Hungarian and Polish presidencies of the Council of the EU did not manage to reach an agreement by the end of their mandates. Finally, it was during the Danish Presidency of the Council that a common position was reached on 26 December 2025. Hence T rilogues interinstitutional negotiations started on 9 December 2025 and are still ongoing. The last trilogue meeting took place on 29 June 2026. No agreement took place under the Cyprus presidency of the Council. The next trilogue under the Irish one is still to be determined.

In parallel on 6 February 2024 the Commission published a proposal on combatting child sexual abuse (both online and offline), which covers also offences such as livestreaming of child sexual abuse and intentional access and dissemination of CSA deepfakes. See our file ' Proposal for a revision of the combating child sexual abuse Directive (2011/93/EU)' for more details.
